takes.h: The soundtrack is the second film
takes.p: Horror scores have done well out of the vinyl revival, and deservedly. A good score holds the film's whole mood in forty minutes you can put on while you read. If you only buy one physical thing for a favourite film this year, consider making it the record.

takes.h: Provenance is a story, not a certificate
takes.p: A book that belonged to someone interesting is more interesting. A book with a convincing story about belonging to someone interesting is merely a book with a story. Ask for the paper trail, and if there is none, pay for the book in front of you and nothing more.

If you want to know who was doing the real work in a decade, ignore the bestseller lists and read the tables of contents of its anthologies. Editors with taste put the next generation beside the last one, and the order of the stories is an argument in itself.
